narration: Starting cold, attention is eight concepts deep. You'll take matrix multiplication first because every layer in this corpus is one, then neurons and layers for the vocabulary, then neural networks as the object a transformer actually is. From there it's dot products, softmax over those dot products, embeddings as the thing attention operates on, and finally attention itself, once nothing inside it is unfamiliar. Twenty-four minutes instead of two hours and twenty. One prerequisite, positional encoding, is referenced by the attention explanation but never taught anywhere in this corpus.
